clauses.text: Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 90 days before the end of the calendar year.
Delivery FCA; standard lead time 35 days from order.
The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.
Valid from 2025-07-01 to 2027-06-30; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 90 days' notice.

documents.subject: Capacity
documents.author: Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
documents.text: Call with sales at Lasertechnik Varnoszeg Kft.: they could take additional parts at short notice; the second shift has been on hold since spring.

documents.subject: Holiday shutdown
documents.author: Lasertechnik Varnoszeg Kft.
documents.text: Our plant is closed from 23 December to 6 January. Please place call-offs for January by 10 December.

persona.summary: Hungarian laser/sheet shop (90 staff, EUR 3.9 M); we are 8.2 % of its turnover and growing 21 %. Second shift on hold since spring and it offered to take more parts at short notice: idle capacity. Gives way easily (kept 10 % of its asks; asked +1.5 %, settled -2.5 %). OTD sliding to 71 % (amber). Open deep; trade volume and forecast for price.
persona.notes: Needs work to restart its second shift; volume is the currency. Only the generic 10-day payment e-mail (equity 35 %, credit flat 248), so no real cash stress. Fears losing a growing account. Amber, falling OTD is a quality lever. 60-day payment terms already favour us.

evidence.quote: they could take additional parts at short notice; the second shift has been on hold since spring.
Could you pay our invoices within 10 days? In return we would grant a cash discount.

levers: additional parts / volume to fill second shift
shorter lead time at no extra cost
arguments: material/energy index, only if it actually fell
avoid: citing a cost driver that rose
giving faster payment for free: it is not distressed
tactics: Open deep: it historically gives away most of its ask.
Offer a binding annual volume and send the volume schedule; that fills its idle shift.
Use the amber OTD (70.8 %) as a separate quality argument.
Ask for a shorter lead time as a free extra: it has spare capacity.
Move in small visible steps, one argument kind per round.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; history shows it settles 3-4 points below its ask, so expect steady movement.
